function runInfo = JH_NLNE_AllFigures(figList, outputDirectory, experimentalMode)
% Journal of Hydrology submission: single-file frozen-secant implementation.
% USAGE (MATLAB R2024a or newer; base MATLAB only):
%   JH_NLNE_AllFigures_Secant_Fast400;                 % all numerical figures
%   JH_NLNE_AllFigures_Secant_Fast400('Fig8');          % one figure
%   info=JH_NLNE_AllFigures_Secant_Fast400({'Fig5','Fig6','Fig8'});
%   info=JH_NLNE_AllFigures_Secant_Fast400('Fig4',[],'final');
% Figures 1-3 are conceptual diagrams, not generated by this file.
% Fig4 embeds digitized observations; independent analytical/FDM/COMSOL
% reference symbols for Figs5-8 are not embedded in the supplied source.
%
% NONLINEAR CONVENTION, used throughout this file:
%   Freundlich: Ksec=KF*C^(N-1).
%   Langmuir:   Ksec=Qm*KL/(1+KL*C).
% Accumulation, equilibrium decay and kinetic terms use the same frozen
% secant field. No separately propagated tangent coefficient is used.
% Fig4's 1000 factor is retained for its mg/g-to-mg/kg conversion.
% The physical rate denominator is exactly s+alpha+lambda (no unitless eps).
% Generic-solver numerical unit convention: c is mg/L (=g/m^3), rho is
% kg/m^3, sorbed amounts and Qm are g/kg, and KL is L/mg (=m^3/g).
% KF is the sorbed amount at Cref=1 mg/L; its numerical value equals the
% source's Freundlich coefficient under this reference convention.
% Fig4 instead uses rho in kg/L and converts Qm from mg/g to mg/kg.
% Molar COMSOL inputs require a consistent aqueous AND sorbed unit conversion.
%
% This reproduces the FROZEN-COEFFICIENT approximation in the manuscript.
% Coefficient iteration at the requested time is not an exact treatment of
% nonlinear transient history. C-step convergence is reported separately
% from coefficient defect; independent accuracy/stability is not implied.
% No COMSOL solutions or numerical-reference data are fabricated here.
%
% SOURCE SETTINGS PRESERVED (do not confuse with older standalone Fig7.m):
% Shared solver: 40 Talbot nodes, 5 homotopy levels, eta=0.55, C-step tol=1e-4,
% maximum 80 Picard iterations/level, coefficient floor 1e-12, 365 days/year.
% Standard cutoff system (Figs8-11): 100+100+200=400 sublayers.
% Layer spacings are 0.01, 0.01 and 0.05 m, respectively.
% FAST400 changes only assembly/evaluation and exact duplicate calculations:
% - sparse entries are assembled together using a precomputed index pattern;
% - output cell locations and Talbot nodes/weights are reused;
% - Fig9b/c share one coefficient iteration for both observation points;
% - Fig10b reuses the identical ks=1e-4/day, f=0.5 curve from Fig10a.
% Iteration rules, physical inputs, sample grids and Origin outputs are kept.
% Do not compare timings against the old 240-cell default as a pure speed test.
% Fig4 defaults to its original fast settings; optional 'final' is provided.
% Effective Fig4 Langmuir capacity and all supplied physical values/data
% remain unchanged. They must be described consistently in the manuscript.
% The final nonnegative clipping of the source is retained and diagnosed.
%
% OUTPUTS: existing Origin_* workspace variables are retained; numeric
% matrices receive an additional *_Table with descriptive column names.
% Separate Origin_Fig8a...Origin_Fig8d and Fig10c numeric datasets are added.
% CSV files use 17 significant digits for numeric tables. Each run writes
% to a new directory. JH_Origin_Manifest documents columns and descriptions.
% JH_Solver_Diagnostics and JH_Stage_Diagnostics record the actual runs,
% including failed C-step criteria. Linear limits bypass nonlinear iteration.
% The multi-time parameter sweeps can take considerably longer than Fig8.
% This file has not been executed in MATLAB during editing.

if nargin<1 || isempty(figList)
    figList={'Fig4','Fig5','Fig6','Fig7','Fig8','Fig9','Fig10','Fig11'};
end
if ischar(figList)||isstring(figList), figList=cellstr(figList); end
assert(iscell(figList),'figList must be a character vector, string array or cell array.');
if nargin<3 || isempty(experimentalMode), experimentalMode='fast'; end
assert(any(strcmpi(experimentalMode,{'fast','final'})),'Experimental mode must be fast or final.');
if nargin<2 || isempty(outputDirectory)
    outputDirectory=fullfile(pwd,['JH_Secant_Origin_' datestr(now,'yyyymmdd_HHMMSS')]);
    if exist(outputDirectory,'dir'), outputDirectory=tempname(pwd); end
else
    outputDirectory=char(outputDirectory);
    assert(~exist(outputDirectory,'dir'),'Choose a new output directory.');
end
mkdir(outputDirectory); close all;
originRegistry('reset',outputDirectory); solverLog('reset');
runInfo=struct('Journal','Journal of Hydrology', ...
    'Implementation','Frozen secant Homotopy-Picard', ...
    'SourceFile',mfilename('fullpath'),'MATLABVersion',version, ...
    'MATLABRelease',version('-release'),'FigureList',{figList}, ...
    'ExperimentalMode',experimentalMode,'OutputDirectory',outputDirectory, ...
    'StandardCutoffLayerCells',[100 100 200],'SharedTalbotNodes',40, ...
    'SharedRelaxationFactor',.55,'SharedHomotopyLevels',5, ...
    'SharedCStepTolerance',1e-4,'SharedMaxPicardPerStage',80, ...
    'SharedConcentrationFloor',1e-12,'SecondsPerYear',365*86400);
assignin('base','JH_Run_Info',runInfo);
fprintf('Journal of Hydrology code: frozen-secant version.\nOutput: %s\n',outputDirectory);
for ii=1:numel(figList)
    tag=lower(strrep(char(figList{ii}),' ',''));
    if ~isempty(tag)&&all(isstrprop(tag,'digit')), tag=['fig' tag]; end
    solverLog('figure',tag);
    figureTimer=tic;
    switch tag
        case 'fig4', make_Fig4_Experiment(experimentalMode,outputDirectory);
        case 'fig5', make_Fig5_TwoLayer();
        case 'fig6', make_Fig6_ThreeLayer();
        case 'fig7', make_Fig7_FDM();
        case 'fig8', make_Fig8_FEM();
        case 'fig9', make_Fig9_Mechanistic();
        case 'fig10', make_Fig10_NEParams();
        case 'fig11', make_Fig11_FreundlichExponent();
        otherwise
            error('JH:FigureTag','Unknown figure tag: %s',tag);
    end
    [diagnostics,stages]=solverLog('tables');
    manifest=originRegistry('table');
    assignin('base','JH_Solver_Diagnostics',diagnostics);
    assignin('base','JH_Stage_Diagnostics',stages);
    assignin('base','JH_Origin_Manifest',manifest);
    writetable(diagnostics,fullfile(outputDirectory,'JH_Solver_Diagnostics.csv'));
    writetable(stages,fullfile(outputDirectory,'JH_Stage_Diagnostics.csv'));
    writetable(manifest,fullfile(outputDirectory,'JH_Origin_Manifest.csv'));
    selected=strcmp(diagnostics.Figure,tag);
    failed=sum(selected & ~diagnostics.AllStageCStepPassed);
    if failed>0
        warning('JH:CStepLimit','%s: %d solution calls reached a stage cap. Inspect JH_Solver_Diagnostics.',tag,failed);
    end
    fprintf('%s completed in %.3f s.\n',tag,toc(figureTimer));
    runInfo.CompletedFigures=figList(1:ii);
    assignin('base','JH_Run_Info',runInfo);
    save(fullfile(outputDirectory,'JH_Run_Metadata.mat'),'runInfo','diagnostics','stages','manifest');
end
fprintf('Completed. Origin matrices/tables and diagnostic tables are in the base workspace.\n');
fprintf('CSV output: %s\n',outputDirectory);
end

function make_Fig4_Experiment(mode, outputDirectory)
% =========================================================================
% Fig. 4 experimental profile validation using the user's 8-column digitized data.
%
% Data mapping supplied by the user:
%   columns 1-2: Fig.4b T-clay red points, 1.8 d, [C_mgL, z_mm]
%   columns 3-4: Fig.4b T-clay purple points, 7.5 d, [C_mgL, z_mm]
%   columns 5-6: Fig.4d B-clay red points, 1.8 d, [C_mgL, z_mm]
%   columns 7-8: Fig.4d B-clay purple points, 7.5 d, [C_mgL, z_mm]
%
% Plot meaning:
%   open markers : experimental points
%   dashed lines : constant equivalent retardation model, R_eq = 1.2
%   solid lines  : present nonlinear Langmuir semi-analytical model
%
% Usage:
%   JH_NLNE_AllFigures_Secant_Fast400('Fig4')
%   JH_NLNE_AllFigures_Secant_Fast400('Fig4', [], 'final')
% =========================================================================

if nargin == 0
    mode = 'fast';
end
%% 1. Digitized experimental points [C_mgL, z_mm]
T_red_1p8d_Cz = [

    12.99647 17.57093
    11.80954 18.00525
    4.88575 18.42872
    12.60083 18.78704
];

T_purple_7p5d_Cz = [
    480.05525 1.21147
    456.31656 1.58100
    429.41271 1.99401
    414.18038 2.40701
    419.32376 2.90696
    401.91539 3.30910
    383.51790 3.71123
    364.52695 4.11337
    337.02963 4.91764
    334.65576 4.49377
    315.07134 5.30891
    303.20199 5.68930
    301.02595 6.11318
    275.50685 6.50444
    253.74638 6.88484

    234.95325 7.79780

    233.37067 8.61294
    218.53399 9.01507

    197.96046 10.21061
    194.99312 10.61275
    177.98039 10.99315
    164.52846 11.40615
    150.08742 11.79742
    154.43952 12.21042
    154.83516 12.69950
    152.46129 13.12338
    134.85510 13.50377
    125.75526 13.90591
    120.21624 14.30805
    106.36867 14.69931
    102.61004 15.10145
    96.47754 15.49271
    85.39949 15.90572
    72.73885 16.30785
    80.65175 16.69912
    81.64086 17.11212
    76.49748 17.62295
    65.61724 18.00334
    51.37403 18.40548
];

B_red_1p8d_Cz = [
    475.10969 0.45983
    458.69043 0.90936
    406.46531 1.34911
    366.70300 1.78887
    348.30551 2.27748
    316.45610 2.71724
    296.87167 3.16676

    210.22545 4.95510
    193.80618 5.39485
    177.58474 5.85415
    160.76984 6.28413
    144.54840 6.74343
    123.38140 7.18318
    111.11640 7.64248
    102.80786 8.09201
    87.57553 8.54154
    69.77151 8.98129
    51.37403 9.44059
    30.60267 9.91943
    16.75510 10.34941
    9.83132 10.76962
    11.80954 11.26801
    7.25962 11.67845
    7.06180 12.17684
    6.46833 12.61659
    6.27051 13.06612
    6.86398 13.53519
    0.92931 13.93585
    5.67704 14.36583
    5.08358 14.84468
    3.89664 15.30398
    6.46833 15.74373
    4.09446 16.20303
    4.88575 16.65255
    3.10535 17.08254
    3.10535 17.54183
    0.00000 17.98159
];

B_purple_7p5d_Cz = [
    493.70500 0.00000
    486.38557 0.89067
    452.75576 1.35041
    440.09512 1.81015
    419.32376 2.26988
    405.08055 2.71006
    382.72661 3.16980
    368.48340 3.61975
    356.02058 4.05993
    344.54688 4.50989

    288.95878 6.75967

    261.65928 8.10954
    246.82260 8.53994
    229.01858 8.98989
    217.54488 9.46919
    205.87335 9.88981
    191.82796 10.36911
    184.90417 10.78972
    186.28893 11.26902
    179.95861 11.71898
    176.99128 12.14937
    175.80434 12.60911
    174.02394 13.05907
    174.61741 13.51881
    166.90233 13.97855
    172.24354 14.41872
    170.46314 14.84911
    166.11104 15.29907
    169.67185 15.74903
    166.90233 16.21855
    166.90233 16.65872
    164.52846 17.10868
    160.96766 17.55864
    158.39597 17.99881
];

% Convert to [z_mm, C_mgL] for interpolation and plotting.
Dat.T_red   = sortrows([T_red_1p8d_Cz(:,2),   T_red_1p8d_Cz(:,1)],   1);
Dat.T_purple = sortrows([T_purple_7p5d_Cz(:,2), T_purple_7p5d_Cz(:,1)], 1);
Dat.B_red   = sortrows([B_red_1p8d_Cz(:,2),   B_red_1p8d_Cz(:,1)],   1);
Dat.B_purple = sortrows([B_purple_7p5d_Cz(:,2), B_purple_7p5d_Cz(:,1)], 1);

%% 2. Physical parameters for the reduced experimental validation
par = struct();
par.C0    = 500;            % mg/L
par.D0    = 3.8e-5;         % m^2/day
par.tau   = 0.28;           % -
par.Daq   = par.tau*par.D0; % m^2/day
par.n     = 0.60;           % -
par.rho_b = 1.20;           % kg/L = 1.2 g/mL
par.R_eq  = 1.20;           % constant equivalent retardation factor
par.LT    = 20e-3;          % m, T-clay thickness
par.LB    = 18e-3;          % m, B-clay thickness

% Langmuir parameter setting for the final validation.
% The batch-fitted parameters reported by Jang et al. are:
%     Qm_batch = 0.210 mg/g, KL_batch = 0.130 L/mg.
% Directly using these two batch parameters gives a very large low-concentration
% retardation factor, R(0) = 55.6, and makes the Laplace-Picard validation
% numerically unstable for the early profiles.
%
% Therefore, this final validation uses an effective chamber-scale Langmuir
% parameter set constrained by the equivalent retardation factor R_eq = 1.2:
%     1000*Qm_eff*KL_eff = (R_eq - 1)*n/rho_b.
% To keep the Langmuir affinity coefficient consistent with the batch fitting,
% KL_eff is set equal to the reported KL_batch = 0.130 L/mg, while Qm_eff is
% back-calculated from R_eq.
Qm_batch = 0.210;                            % mg/g, batch-fitted reference value
KL_batch = 0.130;                            % L/mg, batch-fitted reference value

Kd_eq  = (par.R_eq - 1)*par.n/par.rho_b;     % L/kg, from R_eq = 1.2
KL_eff = KL_batch;                           % L/mg, use the reported Langmuir affinity
Qm_eff = Kd_eq/(1000*KL_eff);                % mg/g, effective chamber-scale capacity

par.Qm = Qm_eff;                             % = 0.00076923 mg/g
par.KL = KL_eff;                             % = 0.130 L/mg

%% 3. Semi-analytical algorithm settings
switch lower(mode)
    case 'final'
        par.Ncell     = 200;
        par.Mtalbot   = 64;
        par.maxPicard = 50;
        par.tolPicard = 1e-4;
        par.relax     = 0.55;
        par.nHomo     = 5;
    otherwise
        par.Ncell     = 60;
        par.Mtalbot   = 32;
        par.maxPicard = 20;
        par.tolPicard = 2e-4;
        par.relax     = 0.55;
        par.nHomo     = 3;
end
par.Cmin = 1e-9;

%% 4. Compute profiles
Times = [1.8, 7.5];       % red and purple points
zT_mm = linspace(0,20,401)';
zB_mm = linspace(0,18,361)';
zT = zT_mm/1000;
zB = zB_mm/1000;

C_T_lin = zeros(numel(zT),2);
C_T_lan = zeros(numel(zT),2);
C_B_lin = zeros(numel(zB),2);
C_B_lan = zeros(numel(zB),2);

fprintf('>>> Computing Fig.4 using user-supplied points (%s mode) ...\n', mode);
for k = 1:2
    t = Times(k);
    C_T_lin(:,k) = profile_linear(t,'Tclay',zT,par);
    C_T_lan(:,k) = profile_langmuir(t,'Tclay',zT,par);
    C_B_lin(:,k) = profile_linear(t,'Bclay',zB,par);
    C_B_lan(:,k) = profile_langmuir(t,'Bclay',zB,par);
end

%% 5. Goodness-of-fit statistics
Met = struct();
% Use a safe interpolation routine for metrics. A few digitized points may
% fall slightly outside the plotting domain because of image digitization
% uncertainty, for example z = 18.00113 mm for B-clay. Those locations are
% clipped to the model domain before interpolation. NaN values are removed
% before calculating NSE and RMSE.
Met.T_red_lin    = metrics_at_exp(Dat.T_red(:,2),    Dat.T_red(:,1),    zT_mm, C_T_lin(:,1));
Met.T_red_lan    = metrics_at_exp(Dat.T_red(:,2),    Dat.T_red(:,1),    zT_mm, C_T_lan(:,1));
Met.T_purple_lin = metrics_at_exp(Dat.T_purple(:,2), Dat.T_purple(:,1), zT_mm, C_T_lin(:,2));
Met.T_purple_lan = metrics_at_exp(Dat.T_purple(:,2), Dat.T_purple(:,1), zT_mm, C_T_lan(:,2));
Met.B_red_lin    = metrics_at_exp(Dat.B_red(:,2),    Dat.B_red(:,1),    zB_mm, C_B_lin(:,1));
Met.B_red_lan    = metrics_at_exp(Dat.B_red(:,2),    Dat.B_red(:,1),    zB_mm, C_B_lan(:,1));
Met.B_purple_lin = metrics_at_exp(Dat.B_purple(:,2), Dat.B_purple(:,1), zB_mm, C_B_lin(:,2));
Met.B_purple_lan = metrics_at_exp(Dat.B_purple(:,2), Dat.B_purple(:,1), zB_mm, C_B_lan(:,2));

fprintf('\n==================== Fig.4 metrics ====================\n');
fprintf('T-clay 1.8 d | constant R: NSE = %.4f, RMSE = %.3f | present: NSE = %.4f, RMSE = %.3f\n', ...
    Met.T_red_lin.NSE, Met.T_red_lin.RMSE, Met.T_red_lan.NSE, Met.T_red_lan.RMSE);
fprintf('T-clay 7.5 d | constant R: NSE = %.4f, RMSE = %.3f | present: NSE = %.4f, RMSE = %.3f\n', ...
    Met.T_purple_lin.NSE, Met.T_purple_lin.RMSE, Met.T_purple_lan.NSE, Met.T_purple_lan.RMSE);
fprintf('B-clay 1.8 d | constant R: NSE = %.4f, RMSE = %.3f | present: NSE = %.4f, RMSE = %.3f\n', ...
    Met.B_red_lin.NSE, Met.B_red_lin.RMSE, Met.B_red_lan.NSE, Met.B_red_lan.RMSE);
fprintf('B-clay 7.5 d | constant R: NSE = %.4f, RMSE = %.3f | present: NSE = %.4f, RMSE = %.3f\n', ...
    Met.B_purple_lin.NSE, Met.B_purple_lin.RMSE, Met.B_purple_lan.NSE, Met.B_purple_lan.RMSE);
fprintf('========================================================\n');

%% 6. Export to workspace
Origin_Fig4_Tclay = [zT_mm, C_T_lin(:,1), C_T_lan(:,1), C_T_lin(:,2), C_T_lan(:,2)];
Origin_Fig4_Bclay = [zB_mm, C_B_lin(:,1), C_B_lan(:,1), C_B_lin(:,2), C_B_lan(:,2)];
Fig4_ModelParams = table(par.C0,par.D0,par.tau,par.n,par.rho_b,par.R_eq,par.Qm,par.KL, ...
    'VariableNames',{'C0_mgL','D0_m2day','tau','n','rho_b_kgL','R_eq','Qm_mgg','KL_Lmg'});
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig4_Tclay',Origin_Fig4_Tclay, ...
    {'z_mm','ConstantR_1p8d_C_mg_L','Secant_1p8d_C_mg_L','ConstantR_7p5d_C_mg_L','Secant_7p5d_C_mg_L'},'T-clay concentration profiles');
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig4_Bclay',Origin_Fig4_Bclay, ...
    {'z_mm','ConstantR_1p8d_C_mg_L','Secant_1p8d_C_mg_L','ConstantR_7p5d_C_mg_L','Secant_7p5d_C_mg_L'},'B-clay concentration profiles');
publishOrigin('DigitizedPoints_Tclay_Red_zC',Dat.T_red,{'z_mm','C_mg_L'},'Embedded digitized experimental observations');
publishOrigin('DigitizedPoints_Tclay_Purple_zC',Dat.T_purple,{'z_mm','C_mg_L'},'Embedded digitized experimental observations');
publishOrigin('DigitizedPoints_Bclay_Red_zC',Dat.B_red,{'z_mm','C_mg_L'},'Embedded digitized experimental observations');
publishOrigin('DigitizedPoints_Bclay_Purple_zC',Dat.B_purple,{'z_mm','C_mg_L'},'Embedded digitized experimental observations');
assignin('base','Fig4_Metrics',Met);
assignin('base','Fig4_ModelParams',Fig4_ModelParams);


%% 7. Export CSV files for Origin plotting
% Each CSV uses paired X-Y columns. In Origin, set C columns as X and z
% columns as Y, then plot line+symbol/line curves.
OriginDir = fullfile(outputDirectory,'Fig4_Origin_Data');
if ~exist(OriginDir,'dir'), mkdir(OriginDir); end

Origin_Fig4a_Tclay_Table = make_origin_table(zT_mm, C_T_lin, C_T_lan, Dat.T_red, Dat.T_purple);
Origin_Fig4b_Bclay_Table = make_origin_table(zB_mm, C_B_lin, C_B_lan, Dat.B_red, Dat.B_purple);

MetricNames = {'T_clay_1p8d'; 'T_clay_7p5d'; 'B_clay_1p8d'; 'B_clay_7p5d'};
NSE_ConstantR = [Met.T_red_lin.NSE; Met.T_purple_lin.NSE; Met.B_red_lin.NSE; Met.B_purple_lin.NSE];
RMSE_ConstantR = [Met.T_red_lin.RMSE; Met.T_purple_lin.RMSE; Met.B_red_lin.RMSE; Met.B_purple_lin.RMSE];
NSE_Present = [Met.T_red_lan.NSE; Met.T_purple_lan.NSE; Met.B_red_lan.NSE; Met.B_purple_lan.NSE];
RMSE_Present = [Met.T_red_lan.RMSE; Met.T_purple_lan.RMSE; Met.B_red_lan.RMSE; Met.B_purple_lan.RMSE];
Fig4_Metrics_Table = table(MetricNames, NSE_ConstantR, RMSE_ConstantR, NSE_Present, RMSE_Present);

writetable(Origin_Fig4a_Tclay_Table, fullfile(OriginDir,'Fig4a_Tclay_Origin.csv'));
writetable(Origin_Fig4b_Bclay_Table, fullfile(OriginDir,'Fig4b_Bclay_Origin.csv'));
writetable(Fig4_Metrics_Table, fullfile(OriginDir,'Fig4_Metrics.csv'));
writetable(Fig4_ModelParams, fullfile(OriginDir,'Fig4_ModelParams.csv'));

assignin('base','Origin_Fig4a_Tclay_Table',Origin_Fig4a_Tclay_Table);
assignin('base','Origin_Fig4b_Bclay_Table',Origin_Fig4b_Bclay_Table);
% Canonical panel names; legacy names above are retained for compatibility.
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig4b_Tclay_Table',Origin_Fig4a_Tclay_Table,{}, ...
    'Fig4b T-clay validation, paired concentration/depth columns');

%% ========================================================================
% Linear model
% ========================================================================
function C = profile_linear(t, clayType, zEval, par)
timer=tic;
Rvec = par.R_eq*ones(par.Ncell,1);
raw = invert_profile(t, clayType, Rvec, zEval, par);
C = max(real(raw),0);
recordSolver(['ConstantR_' clayType],t*86400,par.C0,par.Ncell, ...
    par.Mtalbot,NaN,NaN,[NaN 0 0 1],raw,0,toc(timer));
end

%% ========================================================================
% Present nonlinear Langmuir model
% ========================================================================
function C = profile_langmuir(t, clayType, zEval, par)
timer=tic; stageHistory=zeros(par.nHomo,4);
switch lower(clayType)
    case 'tclay'
        L = par.LT;
    case 'bclay'
        L = par.LB;
    otherwise
        error('Unknown clayType.');
end

zMid = linspace(L/(2*par.Ncell), L-L/(2*par.Ncell), par.Ncell)';
Rold = par.R_eq*ones(par.Ncell,1);
Cold = invert_profile(t, clayType, Rold, zMid, par);
Cold = max(real(Cold),0);

for ih = 1:par.nHomo
    eta = ih/par.nHomo; stagePassed=false;
    for ip = 1:par.maxPicard
        Rtar = (1-eta)*par.R_eq + eta*R_langmuir_secant(Cold, par);
        Rnew = exp((1-par.relax)*log(max(Rold,1e-10)) + par.relax*log(max(Rtar,1e-10)));
        Cnew = invert_profile(t, clayType, Rnew, zMid, par);
        Cnew = max(real(Cnew),0);
        err = max(abs(Cnew-Cold)./(abs(Cnew)+par.Cmin));
        Cold = Cnew;
        Rold = Rnew;
        if err < par.tolPicard
            stagePassed=true; break;
        end
    end
    stageHistory(ih,:)=[eta,ip,err,stagePassed];
end
raw = invert_profile(t, clayType, Rold, zEval, par);
C = max(real(raw),0);
rtarget=R_langmuir_secant(Cold,par);
defect=max(abs(Rold-rtarget)./max(abs(rtarget),realmin));
recordSolver(['Langmuir_' clayType],t*86400,par.C0,par.Ncell, ...
    par.Mtalbot,par.relax,par.tolPicard,stageHistory,raw,defect,toc(timer));
end

function R = R_langmuir_secant(C, par)
C = max(real(C),0);
Ksec = 1000*par.Qm*par.KL./(1 + par.KL*C);   % L/kg, secant
R = 1 + (par.rho_b/par.n)*Ksec;
end

%% ========================================================================
% Talbot inversion and Laplace-domain transfer matrix
% ========================================================================
function C = invert_profile(t, clayType, Rvec, zEval, par)
C = talbot_inversion(@(s) laplace_profile(s, clayType, Rvec, zEval, par), t, par.Mtalbot);
end

function f = talbot_inversion(Fs, t, M)
if t <= 0
    tmp = Fs(1);
    f = zeros(size(tmp));
    return;
end
fsum = [];
for k = 0:M-1
    theta = k*pi/M;
    if k == 0
        s = 2*M/(5*t);
        weight = 0.5*exp(s*t);
    else
        cotth = cot(theta);
        s = 2*M/(5*t)*(theta*cotth + 1i*theta);
        sigma = theta + (theta*cotth - 1)*cotth;
        weight = exp(s*t)*(1 + 1i*sigma);
    end
    Fval = Fs(s);
    if isempty(fsum)
        fsum = zeros(size(Fval));
    end
    fsum = fsum + weight.*Fval;
end
f = real(2/(5*t)*fsum);
end

function Cbar = laplace_profile(s, clayType, Rvec, zEval, par)
[~, segL] = clay_geometry(clayType, numel(Rvec), par);
Csrc_bar = par.C0/s;  % step boundary source
D = par.Daq;
A = total_transfer_matrix(s, Rvec, segL, D);

switch lower(clayType)
    case 'tclay'
        % z = 0 : B-sand/T-clay interface, C = C0
        % z = L : T-sand/T-clay interface, C = 0
        Cleft  = Csrc_bar;
        Cright = 0;
        Gleft  = (Cright - A(1,1)*Cleft)/A(1,2);
    case 'bclay'
        % z = 0 : B-sand/B-clay interface, C = C0
        % z = L : no-flux bottom boundary
        Cleft = Csrc_bar;
        Gleft = -A(2,1)*Cleft/A(2,2);
    otherwise
        error('Unknown clayType.');
end

Cbar = zeros(size(zEval));
for i = 1:numel(zEval)
    Ai = partial_transfer_matrix(s, Rvec, segL, D, zEval(i));
    state = Ai*[Cleft; Gleft];
    Cbar(i) = state(1);
end
end

function [Ltot, segL] = clay_geometry(clayType, N, par)
switch lower(clayType)
    case 'tclay'
        Ltot = par.LT;
    case 'bclay'
        Ltot = par.LB;
    otherwise
        error('Unknown clayType.');
end
segL = (Ltot/N)*ones(N,1);
end

function A = total_transfer_matrix(s, Rvec, segL, D)
A = eye(2);
for j = 1:numel(Rvec)
    A = layer_transfer(s, Rvec(j), segL(j), D) * A;
end
end

function A = partial_transfer_matrix(s, Rvec, segL, D, z)
A = eye(2);
xRemain = z;
for j = 1:numel(Rvec)
    if xRemain <= 0, break; end
    dx = min(segL(j), xRemain);
    A = layer_transfer(s, Rvec(j), dx, D) * A;
    xRemain = xRemain - dx;
end
end

function T = layer_transfer(s, R, L, D)
q  = sqrt(R*s/D);
qL = q*L;
cq = cosh(qL);
sq = sinh(qL);
T = [cq, sq/(D*q); D*q*sq, cq];
end


%% ========================================================================
% Build Origin-ready wide table with paired X-Y columns
% ========================================================================
function T = make_origin_table(z_mm, C_lin, C_lan, Exp_red_zC, Exp_purple_zC)
% Column pairs are arranged as X = concentration and Y = penetration distance.
% Exp_* are [z_mm, C_mgL]; model curves use z_mm and C arrays.
series = {
    'Exp_1p8d',       Exp_red_zC(:,2),   Exp_red_zC(:,1);
    'ConstantR_1p8d', C_lin(:,1),        z_mm;
    'Present_1p8d',   C_lan(:,1),        z_mm;
    'Exp_7p5d',       Exp_purple_zC(:,2), Exp_purple_zC(:,1);
    'ConstantR_7p5d', C_lin(:,2),        z_mm;
    'Present_7p5d',   C_lan(:,2),        z_mm;
};

nmax = 0;
for i = 1:size(series,1)
    nmax = max(nmax, numel(series{i,2}));
end

T = table();
for i = 1:size(series,1)
    name = series{i,1};
    C = series{i,2}(:);
    z = series{i,3}(:);
    Cpad = nan(nmax,1); zpad = nan(nmax,1);
    Cpad(1:numel(C)) = C;
    zpad(1:numel(z)) = z;
    T.([name '_C_mgL']) = Cpad;
    T.([name '_z_mm'])  = zpad;
end
end

%% ========================================================================
% Metrics
% ========================================================================

function M = metrics_at_exp(obs, zExp, zModel, cModel)
obs = obs(:);
zExp = zExp(:);
zmin = min(zModel);
zmax = max(zModel);
zUse = min(max(zExp, zmin), zmax);
pred = interp1(zModel, cModel, zUse, 'pchip');
valid = isfinite(obs) & isfinite(pred);
M = metrics(obs(valid), pred(valid));
M.nUsed = sum(valid);
M.nTotal = numel(obs);
end

function M = metrics(obs, pred)
obs = obs(:); pred = pred(:);
M.RMSE = sqrt(mean((pred-obs).^2));
M.MAE  = mean(abs(pred-obs));
den = sum((obs-mean(obs)).^2);
if den > 0
    M.NSE = 1 - sum((obs-pred).^2)/den;
else
    M.NSE = NaN;
end
if std(obs)>0 && std(pred)>0
    cc = corrcoef(obs,pred);
    M.R2 = cc(1,2)^2;
else
    M.R2 = NaN;
end
end


%% ========================================================================
%  FIGURE 5: Two-layer analytical benchmark
% ========================================================================
function make_Fig5_TwoLayer()
fprintf('\n>>> Fig. 5: two-layer benchmark...\n');
secPerYr = 365*24*3600;
interfaces = [0, 0.5, 1.0];
Lphys = diff(interfaces);
n = [0.4, 0.6];
rho = [1500, 1500];
D0 = [5e-9, 1e-8];
aL = [0, 0];
Rd = [2.0, 1.0];
KF = (Rd - 1).*n./rho;   % m3/kg, linear partition coefficient
N = [1, 1];
f = [1, 1];
alpha = [0, 0];
lam = [0, 0];
vDarcy = 4e-9;           % m/s
C0 = 1;
tYears = [0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8];
z = linspace(0,1,161)';

sys = buildSystemFromVelocity(Lphys,n,rho,D0,aL,vDarcy,0.005);
par.N = expandBySystem(sys,N); par.KF = expandBySystem(sys,KF);
par.f = expandBySystem(sys,f); par.alpha = expandBySystem(sys,alpha); par.lam = expandBySystem(sys,lam);

Cmat = zeros(numel(z),numel(tYears));
for k = 1:numel(tYears)
    Cmat(:,k) = solveFreundlich(tYears(k)*secPerYr,z,C0,sys,par.KF,par.N,par.f,par.alpha,par.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0);
end
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig5_Proposed',[z,Cmat/C0], ...
    {'z_m','t0p5yr_C_over_C0','t1yr_C_over_C0','t2yr_C_over_C0','t4yr_C_over_C0','t8yr_C_over_C0'},'Two-layer profiles');

figure('Color','w','Position',[120 80 560 650],'Name','Fig. 5'); hold on; box on;
cols = lines(numel(tYears));
for k = 1:numel(tYears)
    plot(Cmat(:,k)/C0,z,'-','LineWidth',2.2,'Color',cols(k,:), ...
        'DisplayName',sprintf('t = %.1f yr',tYears(k)));
end
yline(0.5,'k--','LineWidth',1.1,'HandleVisibility','off');
text(0.58,0.25,'Layer 1, R_d = 2','FontName','Times New Roman');
text(0.58,0.75,'Layer 2, R_d = 1','FontName','Times New Roman');
set(gca,'YDir','reverse','FontName','Times New Roman','FontSize',12,'LineWidth',1.1,'TickDir','in');
xlabel('Relative concentration, c/c_0','FontName','Times New Roman');
ylabel('Depth, z (m)','FontName','Times New Roman');
xlim([0 1.05]); ylim([0 1]); legend('Location','northeast','Box','off');
title('Fig. 5. Two-layer analytical benchmark','FontName','Times New Roman');
end

function make_Fig6_ThreeLayer()

lam = [8.3e-10, 0, 0];
vDarcy = 4.76e-10;

gammaSrc = [0, 0.0365/secPerYr];   % constant source and exponentially decaying source

sys = buildSystemFromVelocity(Lphys,n,rho,D0,aL,vDarcy,0.002);
par.N = expandBySystem(sys,N); par.KF = expandBySystem(sys,KF);
par.f = expandBySystem(sys,f); par.alpha = expandBySystem(sys,alpha); par.lam = expandBySystem(sys,lam);

Cmat = zeros(numel(z),4); lab = cell(1,4); ic = 1;
for g = 1:2
    for t = 1:2
        Cmat(:,ic) = solveFreundlich(tYears(t)*secPerYr,z,C0,sys,par.KF,par.N,par.f,par.alpha,par.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',gammaSrc(g),0);
        if g==1, sname='Constant source'; else, sname='Decaying source'; end
        lab{ic} = sprintf('%d yr, %s',tYears(t),sname);
        ic = ic + 1;
    end
end
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig6_Proposed',[z,Cmat/C0], ...
    {'z_m','Constant_t10yr','Constant_t40yr','Decaying_t10yr','Decaying_t40yr'},'Relative concentration profiles');

ylabel('Depth, z (m)','FontName','Times New Roman');
xlim([0 1.05]); ylim([0 1]); legend('Location','northeast','Box','off');
title('Fig. 6. Three-layer source-history benchmark','FontName','Times New Roman');
end

interfaces = [0,0.60,0.61]; Lphys = diff(interfaces);

kh = [1.9e-10,5.0e-11];

KF = [0.63,9.60]*1e-3; N = [0.80,0.98];
f = [1,1]; alpha = [0,0];
lam = [log(2)/(10*secPerYr), log(2)/(10*secPerYr)];
C0List = [5,50,100]; t = 30*secPerYr; z = linspace(0,0.61,400)';
hdiff = 1.0; grad = hdiff/interfaces(end);

sys = buildSystemFromKh(Lphys,n,rho,kh,D0,aL,grad,0.001,false);
kbot = muRobin*sys.n(end)*sys.D(end);
par.N = expandBySystem(sys,N); par.KF = expandBySystem(sys,KF);
par.f = expandBySystem(sys,f); par.alpha = expandBySystem(sys,alpha); par.lam = expandBySystem(sys,lam);

Cmat = zeros(numel(z),numel(C0List));
figure('Color','w','Position',[160 90 600 510],'Name','Fig. 7'); hold on; box on;
cols = [0 0.45 0.74; 0.85 0.33 0.10; 0.47 0.67 0.19];
for i = 1:numel(C0List)
    C = solveFreundlich(t,z,C0List(i),sys,par.KF,par.N,par.f,par.alpha,par.lam,'Dirichlet','Robin',0,kbot);
    Cmat(:,i) = C/C0List(i);
    plot(z,Cmat(:,i),'-','LineWidth',2.3,'Color',cols(i,:),'DisplayName',sprintf('c_0 = %d mg/L',C0List(i)));
end

xlim([0 0.61]); ylim([0 1.05]); legend('Location','northeast','Box','off');

end

%% ========================================================================
%  FIGURE 8: FEM verification scenarios without benchmark symbols

function make_Fig8_FEM()
fprintf('\n>>> Fig. 8: Freundlich and Langmuir FEM verification scenarios...\n');
secPerYr = 365*24*3600;
[sys, base] = standardCutoffSystem([0.01 0.01 0.05]);
C0List = [1,10,50,100]; x = linspace(0,12,25)'; t = 100*secPerYr;
cols = [0 0 0; 0 0.30 0.85; 0.85 0.10 0.10; 0 0.55 0.20];
sty = {'-','--','-.',':'};

figure('Color','w','Position',[80 60 1120 820],'Name','Fig. 8');
allData = struct();
for row = 1:2
    if row==1
        sorp = 'Freundlich';
    else
        sorp = 'Langmuir';
    end
    for col = 1:2
        if col==1, bcIn='Dirichlet'; else, bcIn='Flux'; end
        subplot(2,2,(row-1)*2+col); hold on; box on;
        shadeWall(gca,0,1.05);
        data = x;
        for i = 1:numel(C0List)
            C0 = C0List(i);
            if strcmpi(sorp,'Freundlich')
                C = solveFreundlich(t,x,C0,sys,base.KF,base.N,base.f,base.alpha,base.lam,bcIn,'Neumann',0,0);
            else
                C = solveLangmuir(t,x,C0,sys,base.Qm,base.KL,base.f,base.alpha,base.lam,bcIn,'Neumann',0,0);
            end
            plot(x,C/C0,sty{i},'Color',cols(i,:),'LineWidth',2.1,'DisplayName',sprintf('c_0 = %d mg/L',C0));
            data = [data,C/C0]; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
        set(gca,'FontName','Times New Roman','FontSize',11,'LineWidth',1.1,'TickDir','in');
        xlabel('Distance, x (m)','FontName','Times New Roman'); ylabel('Relative concentration, c/c_0','FontName','Times New Roman');
        xlim([0 12]); ylim([0 1.05]);
        title(sprintf('(%s) %s, %s-Neumann',char(96+(row-1)*2+col),sorp,bcIn),'FontName','Times New Roman');
        if row==1 && col==1, legend('Location','northeast','Box','off'); end
        allData.(sprintf('Fig8_%s_%s',sorp,bcIn)) = data;
        panel=char(96+(row-1)*2+col);
        publishOrigin(['Origin_Fig8' panel],data, ...
            {'x_m','C0_1_C_over_C0','C0_10_C_over_C0','C0_50_C_over_C0','C0_100_C_over_C0'}, ...
            [sorp ', ' bcIn '-Neumann, 100-year profiles']);
    end
end
assignin('base','Origin_Fig8_Proposed',allData);
end

end
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig9a_Profile',[x,Cprof], ...
    {'x_m','EL_C_over_C0','NEL_C_over_C0','ENL_C_over_C0','NENL_C_over_C0'},'100-year concentration profiles');
figure('Color','w','Position',[90 70 1080 800],'Name','Fig. 9');
subplot(2,2,1); hold on; box on; shadeWall(gca,0,1.05);
for i=1:4, plot(x,Cprof(:,i),sty{i},'Color',cols(i,:),'LineWidth',2.2,'DisplayName',modelNames{i}); end
setFigAxes('Position, x (m)','Relative concentration, c/c_0'); xlim([0 3.5]); ylim([0 1.05]);
title('(a) Spatial concentration profiles','FontName','Times New Roman'); legend('Location','northeast','Box','off');

% Fig. 9b-c: BTCs at x = 1 and x = 2
xObs = [1.0,2.0]; tYears = logspace(0,3,70); BTC = zeros(numel(tYears),4,2);
% The coefficient field depends on time/model, not on the output position.
% Evaluate both observation points after a single coefficient iteration.
for it = 1:numel(tYears)
    tt = tYears(it)*secPerYr;
    for i = 1:4
        cBoth = solveFreundlich(tt,xObs,C0,sys,base.KF,models(i).N,models(i).f,models(i).alpha,base.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0)/C0;
        BTC(it,i,:) = reshape(cBoth,1,1,2);
    end
    if mod(it,10)==0 || it==numel(tYears)
        fprintf('  Fig9b/c: %d/%d time samples completed.\n',it,numel(tYears)); drawnow;
    end
end
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig9b_BTC_x1',[tYears',BTC(:,:,1)], ...
    {'Time_years','EL_C_over_C0','NEL_C_over_C0','ENL_C_over_C0','NENL_C_over_C0'},'BTC at x=1 m');
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig9c_BTC_x2',[tYears',BTC(:,:,2)], ...
    {'Time_years','EL_C_over_C0','NEL_C_over_C0','ENL_C_over_C0','NENL_C_over_C0'},'BTC at x=2 m');
for p=1:2
    subplot(2,2,1+p); hold on; box on;
    for i=1:4, plot(tYears,BTC(:,i,p),sty{i},'Color',cols(i,:),'LineWidth',2.1,'DisplayName',modelNames{i}); end
    set(gca,'XScale','log'); setFigAxes('Time, t (year)','Relative concentration, c/c_0');
    xlim([1 1000]); ylim([0 1.05]);
    if p==1, title('(b) Breakthrough curves at x = 1 m','FontName','Times New Roman'); else, title('(c) Breakthrough curves at x = 2 m','FontName','Times New Roman'); end
end

% Fig. 9d: relative error between EL and NENL
xg = linspace(0,3.5,80); tg = logspace(log10(1),log10(1000),60); Err = nan(numel(tg),numel(xg));
for it = 1:numel(tg)
    tt = tg(it)*secPerYr;
    C_EL   = solveFreundlich(tt,xg,C0,sys,base.KF,models(1).N,models(1).f,models(1).alpha,base.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0)/C0;
    C_NENL = solveFreundlich(tt,xg,C0,sys,base.KF,models(4).N,models(4).f,models(4).alpha,base.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0)/C0;
    e = abs(C_EL - C_NENL)./max(C_NENL,1e-8)*100;
    e(C_NENL<1e-5) = NaN;
    Err(it,:) = e;
    if mod(it,10)==0 || it==numel(tg)
        fprintf('  Fig9d: %d/%d time samples completed.\n',it,numel(tg)); drawnow;
    end
end
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig9d_Error_XYZ',xyzFromGrid(xg,tg,Err), ...
    {'x_m','Time_years','Error_pct'},'EL versus NENL relative concentration error');
subplot(2,2,4); hold on; box on;
contourf(xg,tg,Err,18,'LineColor','none'); colorbar; set(gca,'YScale','log');
xline(1,'k--','LineWidth',1.0); xline(2,'k--','LineWidth',1.0);
setFigAxes('Position, x (m)','Time, t (year)'); title('(d) Relative error |c_{EL}-c_{NENL}|/c_{NENL}','FontName','Times New Roman');
end

%% ========================================================================
%  FIGURE 10: Non-equilibrium parameter effects
% ========================================================================
function make_Fig10_NEParams()
fprintf('\n>>> Fig. 10: non-equilibrium parameter effects...\n');
secPerYr = 365*24*3600;
[sys, base] = standardCutoffSystem([0.01 0.01 0.05]);
C0=100; xObs=2.0; threshold=0.1; tYears=logspace(0,3,90);
ks_day = [Inf,1e-1,1e-4,1e-7];
fixedF = 0.5;
fCases = [1.0,0.9,0.5,0.1];
fixedKs = 1e-4;
cols = [0 0 0; 0 0.30 0.85; 0.85 0.10 0.10; 0 0.55 0.20];
sty = {'-','--','-.',':'};

BTC_ks = zeros(numel(tYears),numel(ks_day));
for j=1:numel(ks_day)
    if isinf(ks_day(j)), aLayer = [1e6,1e6,1e6]/86400; else, aLayer = [ks_day(j),ks_day(j),ks_day(j)]/86400; end
    fLayer = [fixedF,fixedF,fixedF];
    alpha = expandBySystem(sys,aLayer); f = expandBySystem(sys,fLayer);
    for it=1:numel(tYears)
        BTC_ks(it,j) = solveFreundlich(tYears(it)*secPerYr,xObs,C0,sys,base.KF,base.N,f,alpha,base.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0)/C0;
        if mod(it,10)==0 || it==numel(tYears)
            fprintf('  curve %d: %d/%d time samples completed.\n',j,it,numel(tYears)); drawnow;
        end
    end
end
BT_ks = breakthroughTimes(tYears,BTC_ks,threshold);

BTC_f = zeros(numel(tYears),numel(fCases));
alphaFixed = expandBySystem(sys,[fixedKs,fixedKs,fixedKs]/86400);
for j=1:numel(fCases)
    % Same time grid, concentration, sorption, boundary and rate parameters.
    reusedColumn=find(ks_day==fixedKs,1);
    if fCases(j)==fixedF && ~isempty(reusedColumn)
        BTC_f(:,j)=BTC_ks(:,reusedColumn);
        fprintf('  Fig10b: f=%.2f reuses the identical Fig10a curve.\n',fCases(j));
        continue;
    end
    f = expandBySystem(sys,[fCases(j),fCases(j),fCases(j)]);
    for it=1:numel(tYears)
        BTC_f(it,j) = solveFreundlich(tYears(it)*secPerYr,xObs,C0,sys,base.KF,base.N,f,alphaFixed,base.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0)/C0;
        if mod(it,10)==0 || it==numel(tYears)
            fprintf('  curve %d: %d/%d time samples completed.\n',j,it,numel(tYears)); drawnow;
        end
    end
end
BT_f = breakthroughTimes(tYears,BTC_f,threshold);
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig10a_ks_BTC',[tYears',BTC_ks], ...
    {'Time_years','ks_1e6_per_day','ks_1e_1_per_day','ks_1e_4_per_day','ks_1e_7_per_day'},'C/C0 at x=2 m; 1e6/day approximates the equilibrium limit');
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig10b_f_BTC',[tYears',BTC_f], ...
    {'Time_years','f_1p0','f_0p9','f_0p5','f_0p1'},'C/C0 at x=2 m');
assignin('base','Origin_Fig10c_BT',{ks_day,BT_ks,fCases,BT_f});
implementedKs=ks_day(:); implementedKs(isinf(implementedKs))=1e6;
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig10c_ks_BT',[ks_day(:),implementedKs,BT_ks(:)], ...
    {'Label_ks_per_day','Implemented_ks_per_day','BreakthroughTime_years'},'Threshold C/C0=0.1; Inf label implemented as 1e6/day');
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig10c_ks_Finite',[ks_day(2:end).',BT_ks(2:end).'], ...
    {'ks_per_day','BreakthroughTime_years'},'Finite ks points plotted in Fig10c');
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig10c_f_BT',[fCases(:),BT_f(:)], ...
    {'f','BreakthroughTime_years'},'Threshold C/C0=0.1');

figure('Color','w','Position',[70 110 1280 390],'Name','Fig. 10');
subplot(1,3,1); hold on; box on;
for j=1:numel(ks_day)
    if isinf(ks_day(j)), lab='k_s \rightarrow \infty'; else, lab=sprintf('k_s = 10^{%d} d^{-1}',round(log10(ks_day(j)))); end
    plot(tYears,BTC_ks(:,j),sty{j},'Color',cols(j,:),'LineWidth',2.1,'DisplayName',lab);
end
yline(threshold,'k:','c/c_0=0.1','HandleVisibility','off'); set(gca,'XScale','log');
setFigAxes('Time, t (year)','Relative concentration, c/c_0'); xlim([1 1000]); ylim([1e-4 1.05]); title('(a) Effect of k_s','FontName','Times New Roman'); legend('Location','southeast','Box','off');

subplot(1,3,2); hold on; box on;
for j=1:numel(fCases)
    plot(tYears,BTC_f(:,j),sty{j},'Color',cols(j,:),'LineWidth',2.1,'DisplayName',sprintf('f_i = %.1f',fCases(j)));
end
yline(threshold,'k:','c/c_0=0.1','HandleVisibility','off'); set(gca,'XScale','log');
setFigAxes('Time, t (year)','Relative concentration, c/c_0'); xlim([1 1000]); ylim([1e-4 1.05]); title('(b) Effect of f_i','FontName','Times New Roman'); legend('Location','southeast','Box','off');

subplot(1,3,3); hold on; box on;
ksPlot = [1e-1,1e-4,1e-7]; btPlot = BT_ks(2:end);
semilogx(ksPlot,btPlot,'s-','LineWidth',2.1,'MarkerFaceColor','w','DisplayName','k_s');
plot(fCases,BT_f,'o-','LineWidth',2.1,'MarkerFaceColor','w','DisplayName','f_i');
set(gca,'XDir','reverse'); setFigAxes('Parameter value','Breakthrough time (year)');
title('(c) Breakthrough-time relationships','FontName','Times New Roman'); legend('Location','best','Box','off');
end

%% ========================================================================
%  FIGURE 11: Freundlich exponent and apparent retardation
% ========================================================================
function make_Fig11_FreundlichExponent()
fprintf('\n>>> Fig. 11: nonlinear Freundlich exponent effects...\n');
secPerYr = 365*24*3600;
[sys, base0] = standardCutoffSystem([0.01 0.01 0.05]);
C0=100; xObs=2.0; Ncases=[1.0,0.85,0.70];
f = expandBySystem(sys,[0.5,0.5,0.5]);
alpha = expandBySystem(sys,[1e-4,1e-4,1e-4]/86400);
tYears=logspace(0,log10(1000),80); x=linspace(0,3.5,200)'; tProfile=100*secPerYr;
cols=[0 0 0;0 0.30 0.85;0.85 0.10 0.10]; sty={'-','--','-.'};
BTC=zeros(numel(tYears),numel(Ncases)); Rprof=zeros(numel(x),numel(Ncases));

for j=1:numel(Ncases)
    N = expandBySystem(sys,[Ncases(j),Ncases(j),Ncases(j)]);
    for it=1:numel(tYears)
        BTC(it,j)=solveFreundlich(tYears(it)*secPerYr,xObs,C0,sys,base0.KF,N,f,alpha,base0.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0)/C0;
        if mod(it,10)==0 || it==numel(tYears)
            fprintf('  curve %d: %d/%d time samples completed.\n',j,it,numel(tYears)); drawnow;
        end
    end
    Csp = solveFreundlich(tProfile,x,C0,sys,base0.KF,N,f,alpha,base0.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0);
    Rprof(:,j)=apparentR_Freundlich(x,Csp,Ncases(j),sys,base0);
end
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig11a_BTC',[tYears',BTC], ...
    {'Time_years','N_1p00','N_0p85','N_0p70'},'C/C0 at x=2 m');
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig11b_Rstar',[x,Rprof], ...
    {'x_m','Rsec_N_1p00','Rsec_N_0p85','Rsec_N_0p70'},'Secant apparent retardation at 100 years');

figure('Color','w','Position',[60 110 1280 390],'Name','Fig. 11');
subplot(1,3,1); hold on; box on;
for j=1:numel(Ncases)
    plot(tYears,BTC(:,j),sty{j},'Color',cols(j,:),'LineWidth',2.2,'DisplayName',sprintf('N_i = %.2f',Ncases(j)));
end
yline(0.1,'k:','c/c_0=0.1','HandleVisibility','off'); set(gca,'XScale','log');
setFigAxes('Time, t (year)','Relative concentration, c/c_0'); xlim([1 1000]); ylim([1e-4 1.05]); title('(a) Breakthrough at x = 2 m','FontName','Times New Roman'); legend('Location','southeast','Box','off');

subplot(1,3,2); hold on; box on; shadeWall(gca,0,max(Rprof(:))*1.05);
for j=1:numel(Ncases)
    plot(x,Rprof(:,j),sty{j},'Color',cols(j,:),'LineWidth',2.2,'DisplayName',sprintf('N_i = %.2f',Ncases(j)));
end
setFigAxes('Position, x (m)','Apparent retardation factor, R_d^*'); xlim([0 3.5]); ylim([0 max(Rprof(:))*1.05]); title('(b) R_d^* at t = 100 years','FontName','Times New Roman');

% Fig. 11c: 10-100 years inside the cutoff wall, according to manuscript comment
xg=linspace(1,2,80); tg=logspace(1,2,55); Err=nan(numel(tg),numel(xg));
Nlin = expandBySystem(sys,[1,1,1]); Nnon = expandBySystem(sys,[0.7,0.7,0.7]);
for it=1:numel(tg)
    Cn = solveFreundlich(tg(it)*secPerYr,xg,C0,sys,base0.KF,Nnon,f,alpha,base0.lam,'Dirichlet','Neumann',0,0);
    Rlin = apparentR_Freundlich(xg,Cn,1.0,sys,base0);
    Rnon = apparentR_Freundlich(xg,Cn,0.7,sys,base0);
    Err(it,:)=(Rlin-Rnon)./max(Rnon,1e-12)*100;
    if mod(it,10)==0 || it==numel(tg)
        fprintf('  Fig11c: %d/%d time samples completed.\n',it,numel(tg)); drawnow;
    end
end
publishOrigin('Origin_Fig11c_Rerror_XYZ',xyzFromGrid(xg,tg,Err), ...
    {'x_m','Time_years','Rsec_error_pct'},'Signed error in secant apparent retardation');
subplot(1,3,3); hold on; box on;
contourf(xg,tg,Err,18,'LineColor','none'); colorbar; set(gca,'YScale','log');
setFigAxes('Position in cutoff wall, x (m)','Time, t (year)'); title('(c) Error in R_d^*, N=1 vs N=0.7','FontName','Times New Roman');
end

%% ========================================================================
%  SHARED MODEL/SOLVER FUNCTIONS
% ========================================================================
function [sys, base] = standardCutoffSystem(dz)
secPerYr = 365*24*3600;
Lphys=[1,1,10]; n=[0.55,0.50,0.55]; rho=[1190,1340,1190]; kh=[1e-6,1e-9,1e-6];
tau=[0.45,0.40,0.45]; Dw=[9.11e-10,6.53e-10,1.07e-9]; aL=[0.44,0.20,0.6183];
hdiff=1.0; grad=hdiff/sum(Lphys);
Dbase = tau.*Dw;  % molecular part after tortuosity
sys = buildSystemFromKh(Lphys,n,rho,kh,Dbase,aL,grad,dz,true);
base.KF = expandBySystem(sys,[0.429,4.45,0.416]*1e-3);
base.N  = expandBySystem(sys,[0.80,0.665,0.80]);
base.f  = expandBySystem(sys,[0.40,0.60,0.40]);
base.alpha = expandBySystem(sys,[1e-4,1e-4,1e-4]/86400);
base.lam = expandBySystem(sys,[log(2)/(50*secPerYr),log(2)/(50*secPerYr),log(2)/(50*secPerYr)]);
% Prescribed Langmuir verification inputs: Qm in g/kg, KL in L/mg.
% Concentration numbers are mg/L (=g/m3), so Qm*KL has units m3/kg.
base.Qm = expandBySystem(sys,[0.07,0.07,0.07]);
base.KL = expandBySystem(sys,[0.05,0.05,0.05]);
base.layerL=Lphys; base.layerN=n; base.layerRho=rho; base.layerKF=[0.429,4.45,0.416]*1e-3;
end

function sys = buildSystemFromKh(Lphys,n,rho,kh,D0,aL,grad,dz,khHarmonic)
if nargin<9, khHarmonic=true; end
if khHarmonic
    Keq = sum(Lphys)/sum(Lphys./kh);
    vDarcy = Keq*grad;
else
    Keq = sum(Lphys)/sum(Lphys./kh);
    vDarcy = Keq*grad;
end
sys = buildSystemFromVelocity(Lphys,n,rho,D0,aL,vDarcy,dz);
end

function sys = buildSystemFromVelocity(Lphys,n,rho,D0,aL,vDarcy,dz)
L=[]; nv=[]; rhov=[]; vv=[]; Dv=[]; layerId=[];
if isscalar(dz), dz=repmat(dz,size(Lphys)); end
assert(numel(dz)==numel(Lphys) && all(isfinite(dz)) && all(dz>0), ...
    'Supply one positive spacing or one per physical layer.');
for i=1:numel(Lphys)
    m=ceil(Lphys(i)/dz(i)); dzi=Lphys(i)/m; oi=ones(1,m);
    vp=vDarcy/n(i);
    D=D0(i)+aL(i)*vp;
    L=[L,oi*dzi]; nv=[nv,oi*n(i)]; rhov=[rhov,oi*rho(i)]; vv=[vv,oi*vp]; Dv=[Dv,oi*D]; layerId=[layerId,oi*i]; %#ok<AGROW>
end
sys.L=L; sys.n=nv; sys.rho=rhov; sys.v=vv; sys.D=Dv; sys.layerId=layerId; sys.edges=[0,cumsum(L)];
% Each interface contributes four concentration and four flux entries.
% The pattern is unchanged across all Talbot nodes and Picard iterations.
mi=numel(L); ii=(1:mi-1)';
rows=[2*ii+zeros(numel(ii),4),2*ii+ones(numel(ii),4)];
cols=(2*ii-1)+[0 1 2 3 0 1 2 3];
sys.matrixRows=[1;1;reshape(rows.',[],1);2*mi;2*mi];
sys.matrixCols=[1;2;reshape(cols.',[],1);2*mi-1;2*mi];
end

function vec = expandBySystem(sys,layerVals)
vec = zeros(size(sys.L));
for i=1:max(sys.layerId)
    vec(sys.layerId==i)=layerVals(i);
end
end

function models = defineMechanisticModels(base)
% EL: linear equilibrium; NEL: linear non-equilibrium; ENL: nonlinear equilibrium; NENL: full model
models(1).N = ones(size(base.N)); models(1).f = ones(size(base.f)); models(1).alpha = base.alpha;
models(2).N = ones(size(base.N)); models(2).f = base.f; models(2).alpha = base.alpha;
models(3).N = base.N; models(3).f = ones(size(base.f)); models(3).alpha = base.alpha;
models(4).N = base.N; models(4).f = base.f; models(4).alpha = base.alpha;
end

function C = solveFreundlich(t,xEval,C0,sys,KF,N,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot)
timer=tic;
% Homotopy-Picard with frozen secant coefficients for Freundlich sorption.
if max(abs(N-1))<1e-12
    Ksec = KF;
    C = computeLaplace(t,xEval,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot);
    raw=C; C=max(real(raw),0);
    recordSolver('LinearFreundlichLimit',t,C0,numel(sys.L),40,NaN,NaN, ...
        [NaN 0 0 1],raw,0,toc(timer));
    return;
end
xMid = sys.edges(1:end-1)+sys.L/2;
pSteps = linspace(0,1,5);
stageHistory=zeros(numel(pSteps),4);
Ksec = KF;
Ccur = computeLaplace(t,xMid,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot);
Ccur = max(real(Ccur),0);
for h=1:numel(pSteps)
    Neff = 1 + pSteps(h)*(N-1); stagePassed=false;
    for iter=1:80
        Cs = max(Ccur,1e-12);
        KsecTarget = KF.*(Cs.^(Neff-1));
        w = 0.55;
        Ksec = (1-w)*Ksec + w*KsecTarget;
        Cnew = computeLaplace(t,xMid,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot);
        Cnew = max(real(Cnew),0);
        err = max(abs(Cnew-Ccur)./(abs(Cnew)+1e-10));
        Ccur = Cnew;
        if err < 1e-4, stagePassed=true; break; end
    end
    stageHistory(h,:)=[pSteps(h),iter,err,stagePassed];
end
C = computeLaplace(t,xEval,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot);
raw=C; C=max(real(raw),0);
target=KF.*max(Ccur,1e-12).^(N-1);
defect=max(abs(Ksec-target)./max(abs(target),realmin));
recordSolver('Freundlich',t,C0,numel(sys.L),40,.55,1e-4, ...
    stageHistory,raw,defect,toc(timer));
end

function C = solveLangmuir(t,xEval,C0,sys,Qm,KL,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot)
timer=tic;
xMid = sys.edges(1:end-1)+sys.L/2;
pSteps = linspace(0,1,5);
stageHistory=zeros(numel(pSteps),4);
Ksec = Qm.*KL;
Ccur = computeLaplace(t,xMid,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot);
Ccur = max(real(Ccur),0);
for h=1:numel(pSteps)
    g = pSteps(h); stagePassed=false;
    for iter=1:80
        Cs = max(Ccur,1e-12);
        denom = 1 + g.*KL.*Cs;
        KsecTarget = (Qm.*KL)./denom;
        w=0.55;
        Ksec=(1-w)*Ksec+w*KsecTarget;
        Cnew = computeLaplace(t,xMid,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot);
        Cnew = max(real(Cnew),0);
        err=max(abs(Cnew-Ccur)./(abs(Cnew)+1e-10));
        Ccur=Cnew;
        if err<1e-4, stagePassed=true; break; end
    end
    stageHistory(h,:)=[g,iter,err,stagePassed];
end
C=computeLaplace(t,xEval,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot);
raw=C; C=max(real(raw),0);
target=(Qm.*KL)./(1+KL.*max(Ccur,1e-12));
defect=max(abs(Ksec-target)./max(abs(target),realmin));
recordSolver('Langmuir',t,C0,numel(sys.L),40,.55,1e-4, ...
    stageHistory,raw,defect,toc(timer));
end

function C = computeLaplace(t,xEval,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot)
if t<=0, C=zeros(size(xEval)); return; end
M=40; val=zeros(size(xEval));
[nodes,weights]=sharedTalbotRule(t,M);
plan=sharedEvaluationPlan(sys.edges,xEval);
for k=1:M
    Cs = solveMatrix(nodes(k),xEval,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot,plan);
    % Preserve the source's node order and summation order.
    val = val + weights(k).*Cs;
end
C = 2/(5*t)*real(val);
end

function [nodes,weights] = sharedTalbotRule(t,M)
% All Picard iterations at one requested time use exactly the same rule.
persistent lastTime lastM cachedNodes cachedWeights
if isempty(lastTime) || ~isequal(t,lastTime) || ~isequal(M,lastM)
    nodes=complex(zeros(1,M)); weights=complex(zeros(1,M));
    for k=0:M-1
        if k==0
            s=2*M/5/t; gam=0.5*exp(s*t);
        else
            theta=k*pi/M;
            s=2*M/5/t*(theta*cot(theta)+1i*theta);
            sigma=theta+(theta*cot(theta)-1)*cot(theta);
            gam=exp(s*t)*(1+1i*sigma);
        end
        nodes(k+1)=s; weights(k+1)=gam;
    end
    lastTime=t; lastM=M; cachedNodes=nodes; cachedWeights=weights;
else
    nodes=cachedNodes; weights=cachedWeights;
end
end

function plan = sharedEvaluationPlan(edges,xEval)
% Cache geometry only. No concentration or nonlinear state is reused.
% Exact equality of both grids is required for every hit.
persistent savedEdges savedX savedPlans
if isempty(savedPlans), savedEdges={}; savedX={}; savedPlans={}; end
for j=1:numel(savedPlans)
    if isequal(edges,savedEdges{j}) && isequal(xEval,savedX{j})
        plan=savedPlans{j}; return;
    end
end
xcol=xEval(:); edgecol=edges(:);
% Same left-cell ownership at interfaces as the source's find(...+1e-12).
plan.id=1+sum(xcol>edges(2:end-1)+1e-12,2);
plan.local=xcol-edgecol(plan.id);
plan.a=2*plan.id-1; plan.b=2*plan.id;
if numel(savedPlans)>=16
    savedEdges(1)=[]; savedX(1)=[]; savedPlans(1)=[];
end
savedEdges{end+1}=edges; savedX{end+1}=xEval; savedPlans{end+1}=plan;
end

function val = solveMatrix(s,xEval,C0,sys,Ksec,f,alpha,lam,bcIn,bcOut,gammaSrc,kbot,plan)
L=sys.L; n=sys.n; rho=sys.rho; D=sys.D; v=sys.v; m=numel(L);
acc = s.*(1 + (rho./n).*f.*Ksec);
dec = lam.*(1 + (rho./n).*f.*Ksec);
kin = (rho./n).*(alpha.*(1-f).*(s+lam).*Ksec)./(s+alpha+lam);
Psi = acc + dec + kin;
delta = sqrt(v.^2 + 4.*D.*Psi);
Lam1 = (v + delta)./(2.*D);
Lam2 = (v - delta)./(2.*D);
Kap = n.*D;
Nunk=2*m; b=zeros(Nunk,1); C0s=C0/(s+gammaSrc);
if strcmpi(bcIn,'Flux')
    inlet=[exp(-Lam1(1)*L(1))*(v(1)-D(1)*Lam1(1)); v(1)-D(1)*Lam2(1)];
    b(1)=v(1)*C0s;
else
    inlet=[exp(-Lam1(1)*L(1));1]; b(1)=C0s;
end
E2=exp(Lam2(1:m-1).*L(1:m-1));
E1n=exp(-Lam1(2:m).*L(2:m));
middle=[ones(m-1,1),E2(:),-E1n(:),-ones(m-1,1), ...
    (Kap(1:m-1).*Lam1(1:m-1)).', ...
    (Kap(1:m-1).*Lam2(1:m-1).*E2).', ...
    -(Kap(2:m).*Lam1(2:m).*E1n).', ...
    -(Kap(2:m).*Lam2(2:m)).'];
Em=exp(Lam2(m)*L(m));
if strcmpi(bcOut,'Robin')
    outlet=[Kap(m)*Lam1(m)+kbot;(Kap(m)*Lam2(m)+kbot)*Em];
else
    outlet=[Lam1(m);Lam2(m)*Em];
end
entries=[inlet;reshape(middle.',[],1);outlet];
A=sparse(sys.matrixRows,sys.matrixCols,entries,Nunk,Nunk);
coef=A\b;
id=plan.id; Lcol=L(:); r1=Lam1(:); r2=Lam2(:);
out=coef(plan.a).*exp(-r1(id).*(Lcol(id)-plan.local)) ...
    +coef(plan.b).*exp(r2(id).*plan.local);
val=reshape(out,size(xEval));
end

function shadeWall(ax,ymin,ymax)
axes(ax); %#ok<LAXES>
patch([1 2 2 1],[ymin ymin ymax ymax],[0.94 0.94 0.94], ...
    'EdgeColor','none','FaceAlpha',0.55,'HandleVisibility','off');
xline(1,'k--','LineWidth',0.9,'HandleVisibility','off');
xline(2,'k--','LineWidth',0.9,'HandleVisibility','off');
uistack(findobj(ax,'Type','Patch'),'bottom');
end

function setFigAxes(xlab,ylab)
set(gca,'FontName','Times New Roman','FontSize',11,'LineWidth',1.1,'TickDir','in');
xlabel(xlab,'FontName','Times New Roman'); ylabel(ylab,'FontName','Times New Roman');
end

function XYZ = xyzFromGrid(x,y,Z)
[X,Y]=meshgrid(x,y); XYZ=[X(:),Y(:),Z(:)];
end

function bt = breakthroughTimes(tYears,BTC,thr)
bt = nan(1,size(BTC,2));
for j=1:size(BTC,2)
    y=BTC(:,j);
    idx=find(y>=thr,1,'first');
    if isempty(idx)
        bt(j)=NaN;
    elseif idx==1
        bt(j)=tYears(1);
    else
        bt(j)=interp1(y(idx-1:idx),tYears(idx-1:idx),thr,'linear','extrap');
    end
end
end

function R = apparentR_Freundlich(x,C,Nval,sys,base)
% Secant apparent retardation; this is not ds_eq/dc.
R=zeros(size(x));
for i=1:numel(x)
    lid=find(x(i)<=cumsum(base.layerL)+1e-12,1,'first'); if isempty(lid), lid=numel(base.layerL); end
    Csafe=max(C(i),1e-12);
    R(i)=1+(base.layerRho(lid)/base.layerN(lid))*base.layerKF(lid)*(Csafe.^(Nval-1));
end
end

%% ========================================================================
%  REPRODUCIBLE WORKSPACE EXPORTS AND SOLVER DIAGNOSTICS
% ========================================================================
function publishOrigin(name,data,columns,description)
if istable(data)
    T=data;
    assignin('base',name,T);
    if endsWith(name,'_Table')
        assignin('base',[name(1:end-6) '_Matrix'],table2array(T));
    else
        assignin('base',[name '_Table'],T);
    end
else
    assert(isnumeric(data)&&ismatrix(data),'Origin data must be a numeric matrix or table.');
    assert(numel(columns)==size(data,2),'Origin column names do not match the data.');
    columns=matlab.lang.makeUniqueStrings(matlab.lang.makeValidName(columns));
    T=array2table(data,'VariableNames',columns);
    assignin('base',name,data);
    assignin('base',[name '_Table'],T);
end
folder=originRegistry('folder');
filename=fullfile(folder,[name '.csv']);
writeOriginCSV(filename,T);
originRegistry('add',name,filename,height(T),width(T), ...
    strjoin(T.Properties.VariableNames,' | '),description);
end

function writeOriginCSV(filename,T)
% Preserve 17 significant digits for numeric Origin datasets.
isNumeric=all(varfun(@isnumeric,T,'OutputFormat','uniform'));
if ~isNumeric
    writetable(T,filename); return;
end
fid=fopen(filename,'w');
assert(fid>=0,'Cannot open output file: %s',filename);
guard=onCleanup(@() fclose(fid)); %#ok<NASGU>
fprintf(fid,'%s\n',strjoin(T.Properties.VariableNames,','));
fmt=[repmat('%.17g,',1,width(T)-1),'%.17g\n'];
fprintf(fid,fmt,table2array(T).');
end

function out=originRegistry(action,varargin)
persistent folder records
out=[];
switch action
    case 'reset'
        folder=varargin{1}; records=cell(0,6);
    case 'folder'
        out=folder;
    case 'add'
        row={string(varargin{1}),string(varargin{2}),varargin{3}, ...
            varargin{4},string(varargin{5}),string(varargin{6})};
        if isempty(records)
            records=row;
        else
            idx=find(strcmp(string(records(:,1)),string(varargin{1})),1);
            if isempty(idx), records(end+1,:)=row; else, records(idx,:)=row; end
        end
    case 'table'
        out=cell2table(records,'VariableNames', ...
            {'WorkspaceVariable','CSVFile','Rows','Columns','ColumnNames','Description'});
    otherwise
        error('JH:OriginRegistry','Unknown registry action.');
end
end

function recordSolver(sorption,t,C0,nSub,M,relax,tol,hist,raw,defect,elapsed)
% Hist columns: gamma, Picard iteration count, relative C step, pass flag.
% A C-step pass is not silently relabeled as full nonlinear/PDE convergence.
r=struct('Sorption',sorption,'Time_s',t,'C0',C0,'Nsub',nSub, ...
    'M',M,'Relax',relax,'Tol',tol,'Stages',size(hist,1), ...
    'Iterations',sum(hist(:,2)),'CStepPassed',all(hist(:,4)==1), ...
    'FinalCStep',hist(end,3),'Defect',defect, ...
    'RawMin',min(real(raw(:)))/C0,'RawMax',max(real(raw(:)))/C0, ...
    'ClippedCount',sum(real(raw(:))<0),'Elapsed_s',elapsed);
solverLog('add',r,hist);
end

function varargout=solverLog(action,varargin)
persistent currentFigure records stageRecords solveID
varargout=cell(1,nargout);
switch action
    case 'reset'
        currentFigure=''; records=cell(0,18); stageRecords=cell(0,8); solveID=0;
    case 'figure'
        currentFigure=varargin{1};
    case 'add'
        r=varargin{1}; hist=varargin{2}; solveID=solveID+1;
        records(end+1,:)={string(currentFigure),solveID,string(r.Sorption), ...
            r.Time_s,r.C0,r.Nsub,r.M,r.Relax,r.Tol,r.Stages,r.Iterations, ...
            r.CStepPassed,r.FinalCStep,r.Defect,r.RawMin,r.RawMax, ...
            r.ClippedCount,r.Elapsed_s};
        for j=1:size(hist,1)
            stageRecords(end+1,:)={string(currentFigure),solveID,string(r.Sorption), ...
                j,hist(j,1),hist(j,2),hist(j,3),logical(hist(j,4))}; %#ok<AGROW>
        end
    case 'tables'
        varargout{1}=cell2table(records,'VariableNames',{'Figure','SolveID', ...
            'Sorption','Time_s','C0_mg_L','Sublayers','TalbotNodes', ...
            'RelaxationFactor','CStepTolerance','Stages','PicardIterations', ...
            'AllStageCStepPassed','FinalRelativeCStep','FinalSecantDefect', ...
            'FinalRawMin_over_C0','FinalRawMax_over_C0', ...
            'FinalNegativeClippedCount','ComputationTime_s'});
        varargout{2}=cell2table(stageRecords,'VariableNames',{'Figure','SolveID', ...
            'Sorption','Stage','Gamma','PicardIterations','FinalRelativeCStep','CStepPassed'});
    otherwise
        error('JH:SolverLog','Unknown solver-log action.');
end
end
